name: form-encoded body is refused before authorize

body.message: Request content type must be application/json.

note: The JSON content-type gate is the CSRF-equivalent on cookie-authenticated mounts: a cross-site HTML form can only send urlencoded/multipart/text-plain, and a cross-origin fetch that sets application/json is CORS-preflighted (never granted by the library). Runners serialize `body` as JSON but MUST send the declared `content_type` header; the handler rejects on the header, not the bytes.
